title: Meeting Fremont Mayor Raj Salwan
description1: Variable Velocity met with Fremont Mayor Raj Salwan at an event hosted at BASIS Independent Fremont. Our team took the stage to introduce Variable Velocity, share our journey in FIRST Tech Challenge, and present to an audience of students and families.
description2: Team members joined a panel discussion with the Mayor, speaking about the value of hands-on STEM and robotics for young people in our city and why community support for programs like FIRST matters.
bullets: Presented our team and FIRST Tech Challenge on stage
Joined a panel discussion with the Mayor
Advocated for STEM and robotics opportunities for Fremont students
